news.text: Our paper [STIndex: A Context-Aware Multi-Dimensional Spatiotemporal Information Extraction System](https://dl.acm.org/doi/pdf/10.1145/3774905.3793103) was accepted at WWW 2026!
Our paper [Trans-RAG: Query-Centric Vector Transformation for Secure Cross-Organizational Retrieval](https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-981-92-0372-7_35) was accepted at DASFAA 2026!

Our paper ["Enhancing reliability in LLM-integrated robotic systems: A unified approach to security and safety"](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0164121225002833) was published in the Journal of Systems and Software!

Our paper [Docs2KG: A Human-LLM Collaborative Approach to Unified Knowledge Graph Construction from Heterogeneous Documents](https://dl.acm.org/doi/pdf/10.1145/3701716.3715309) was published in the WWW 2025!

Our paper [OpenOmni: A collaborative open source tool for building future-ready multimodal conversational agents](https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-demo.5.pdf) won the Best Demo Paper Award at EMNLP 2024!
Joined [Telstra](https://www.telstra.com.au) as a Data Science Specialist, building GraphRAG and agentic retrieval for frontline customer service.

Our paper [A Study on Prompt Injection Attack Against LLM-Integrated Mobile Robotic Systems
](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/10771340) was presented at ISSRE 2024!
Started my PhD in Computer Science at [UWA](https://www.uwa.edu.au), researching reliable and secure LLM agent systems!
Began tutoring at [UWA](https://www.uwa.edu.au): Cloud Computing, Intelligent Agents, Web Development, Cybersecurity, and Databases.
